source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

song.pick: Which song comes from the musical {label}?
song.statement: The song "{value}" comes from the musical {label}.
song.match: Match each musical to one of its best-known songs.
song.reverse: Which of these musicals features the song "{value}"?

rows.label: Hamilton
rows.description: 2015 musical by Lin-Manuel Miranda about Alexander Hamilton
rows.hook: tells the story of a Founding Father through hip-hop and a diverse cast

rows.label: The Phantom of the Opera
rows.description: musical with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: follows a masked composer who haunts a Paris theatre and obsesses over a young soprano

rows.label: The Rocky Horror Show
rows.description: British musical by Richard O'Brien (1973)
rows.hook: features a mad scientist from Transylvania and audiences who dress up and shout back at the stage

rows.label: Les Misérables
rows.description: 1980 musical composed by Claude-Michel Schönberg, libretto by Alain Boublil, lyrics by Alain Boublil and Jean-Marc Natel
rows.hook: follows a paroled convict hunted by a relentless inspector through decades of French upheaval

rows.label: Cabaret
rows.description: theatrical musical by John Kander debuted in 1966
rows.hook: is set in a decadent Berlin nightclub with a sinister emcee before World War II

rows.label: Rent
rows.description: rock musical, loosely based on La Bohème, set in New York during the AIDS Crisis
rows.hook: follows struggling young artists in New York's East Village facing poverty and illness

rows.label: Dear Evan Hansen
rows.description: 2015 American musical by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul

rows.label: Chicago
rows.description: 1975 musical by John Kander and Fred Ebb
rows.hook: tells of murderous vaudeville performers who turn their trials into media stardom

rows.label: Jesus Christ Superstar
rows.song: I Don't Know How to Love Him
rows.description: 1971 rock opera by Andrew Lloyd Webber

rows.label: West Side Story
rows.description: American musical with a book by Arthur Laurents, music by Leonard Bernstein and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim
rows.hook: reimagines Romeo and Juliet with rival street gangs in New York

rows.label: Cats
rows.description: 1981 musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: features dancers in feline costumes gathering at a junkyard ball to see who will be reborn

rows.label: Fiddler on the Roof
rows.song: If I Were a Rich Man
rows.description: 1964 musical
rows.hook: follows a Russian village dairyman struggling to keep tradition as his daughters choose husbands

rows.label: Wicked
rows.description: 2003 musical based on the 1995 Gregory Maguire's novel
rows.hook: retells The Wizard of Oz from the point of view of the green-skinned witch

rows.label: Annie
rows.description: Broadway musical
rows.hook: follows a red-haired orphan who is taken in by a billionaire

rows.label: The Sound of Music
rows.description: 1959 musical
rows.hook: follows a nun-in-training who becomes governess to the seven children of an Austrian captain

rows.label: Little Shop of Horrors
rows.description: 1982 horror comedy rock musical, by composer Alan Menken and writer Howard Ashman
rows.hook: features a carnivorous alien plant that demands to be fed by a meek florist's assistant

rows.label: Into the Woods
rows.description: 1987 musical with music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim and book by James Lapine
rows.hook: weaves together fairy tales like Cinderella and Rapunzel as characters chase their wishes

rows.label: Evita
rows.description: 1978 musical by Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice

rows.label: Hair
rows.description: 1967 rock musical; book and lyrics by Gerome Ragni and James Rado, music by Galt MacDermot

rows.label: Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat
rows.description: musical by Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber
rows.hook: retells a Bible story of a favored son with a many-colored robe and jealous brothers

rows.label: Miss Saigon
rows.description: 1989 stage musical

rows.label: Guys and Dolls
rows.description: 1950 American musical with music and lyrics by Frank Loesser and book by Jo Swerling and Abe Burrows
rows.hook: follows New York gamblers betting on love, with a mission worker caught in the middle

rows.label: The Pirates of Penzance
rows.description: 1879 comic opera by Gilbert & Sullivan

rows.label: Chess
rows.description: musical with music by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus of the pop group ABBA, lyrics by Ulvaeus and Tim Rice, and book by Rice
rows.hook: stages a Cold War rivalry between two grandmasters and the woman between them

rows.label: Grease
rows.description: 1972 musical
rows.hook: follows a leather-jacketed motorbike-loving boy and a good girl at Rydell High

rows.label: Oklahoma!
rows.description: 1943 musical; first musical written by the team of Rodgers and Hammerstein

rows.label: A Chorus Line
rows.description: musical by Marvin Hamlisch
rows.hook: shows dancers auditioning for a spot in a Broadway ensemble and baring their life stories

rows.label: My Fair Lady
rows.song: I Could Have Danced All Night
rows.description: 1956 musical based on Shaw's "Pygmalion"
rows.hook: has a phonetics professor teach a Cockney flower seller to speak proper English

rows.label: Porgy and Bess
rows.description: opera composed in 1934 by George Gershwin

rows.label: Oliver!
rows.description: British musical, with music and lyrics by Lionel Bart
rows.hook: follows a workhouse orphan who asks for more gruel and falls in with young pickpockets in London

rows.label: South Pacific
rows.description: 1949 musical by Richard Rodgers, Oscar Hammerstein II, and Joshua Logan

rows.label: Billy Elliot the Musical
rows.description: musical based on the 2000 film Billy Elliot
rows.hook: follows a miner's son in a northern English town who trades boxing gloves for ballet shoes

rows.label: The Lion King
rows.description: 1997 stage musical with music by Elton John, lyrics by Tim Rice, and book by Roger Allers and Irene Mecchi based on the 1994 Disney animated film of the same name
rows.hook: features elaborate animal puppets telling of a cub who must reclaim his father's throne

rows.label: The King and I
rows.description: 1951 musical by the team of composer Richard Rodgers and dramatist Oscar Hammerstein II
rows.hook: follows an English schoolteacher hired to educate the many children of Siam's monarch

rows.label: Hairspray
rows.description: American musical
rows.hook: follows a plus-sized teen who dances onto a Baltimore TV show and fights segregation

rows.label: The Threepenny Opera
rows.description: 1928 musical play by Bertolt Brecht; adapted from John Gay's 18th-century ballad opera The Beggar's Opera with music by Kurt Weill and insertion ballads by François Villon and Rudyard Kipling
